description: Interface defining database operations related to 'Encounter' entities in the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: EncounterDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for performing database operations related to Encounter entities.

methods.name: saveEncounter
methods.description: Saves an Encounter object to the database.

methods.name: deleteEncounter
methods.description: Deletes an Encounter object from the database.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves an Encounter by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatientId
methods.description: Retrieves all encounters associated with a specific patient ID.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves encounters based on search criteria encapsulated in EncounterSearchCriteria object.

methods.name: saveEncounterType
methods.description: Saves an EncounterType object to the database.

methods.name: deleteEncounterType
methods.description: Deletes an EncounterType from the database.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType by its name string.

methods.name: getAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all EncounterType entries, optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: findEncounterTypes
methods.description: Finds EncounterTypes matching a case-insensitive name pattern.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterDatetime
methods.description: Gets the encounterDatetime currently stored in the database for a specific encounter, bypassing caches.

methods.name: getEncounterByUuid
methods.description: Finds an Encounter based on its UUID.

methods.name: getEncounterTypeByUuid
methods.description: Finds an EncounterType based on its UUID.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves encounters matching a search query, patient ID, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the Location associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: getAllEncounters
methods.description: Gets all encounters associated with a cohort of patients.

methods.name: getCountOfEncounters
methods.description: Returns the total count of encounters matching a search query and patient ID, considering whether to include voided encounters.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves encounters associated with a specific visit.

methods.name: saveEncounterRole
methods.description: Saves an EncounterRole to the database.

methods.name: deleteEncounterRole
methods.description: Removes an EncounterRole from the database.

methods.name: getEncounterRole
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterRole by its ID.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByUuid
methods.description: Finds an EncounterRole by UUID.

methods.name: getAllEncounterRoles
methods.description: Returns a list of all EncounterRoles, with option to include retired ones.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByName
methods.description: Finds an EncounterRole by its name.

methods.name: getEncountersNotAssignedToAnyVisit
methods.description: Retrieves encounters for a patient not assigned to any visit.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatient
methods.description: Retrieves encounters for a patient given visit inclusion, search query, and pagination.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatientCount
methods.description: Counts encounters for a patient based on visit inclusion and search query.

methods.name: getEncounterRolesByName
methods.description: Finds encounter roles matching a given name.
